rows.context_and_review_note: Corrected yan yir to yan yiri, restoring the final vowel of the reviewed iri edge noun in its attached-state form. Retained feminine yat tiɣmrt corner and the interior-selected-area distinction. jbd is used here as an ordinary Moroccan pull/drag imperative with an onscreen handle object; this is a contextual language judgment, not a claim of attested standard software terminology. ImageCropDialog.kt:23 labels CropPreview, :39–42 handles continuous touch down/move/up/cancel. CropOverlay.kt:25–28 prioritizes a nearby edge/corner handle, otherwise selects interior handle 8; :39–42 translates the whole crop for handle 8 and the following branch changes bounds for edge/corner handles. The feminine tt refers to the selected area, not the image or canvas. No claim of panning the preview, resizing by dragging inside, or cropping before Apply is introduced.
